get_cpuinfo: run lscpu and parse the output into a dictionary of CPU attributes and values
get_cpu_vendor: determine the CPU vendor as intel, amd, or arm from a parsed lscpu dictionary
get_amd_zen_generation: detect the AMD Zen generation such as zen4 or zen5 from lscpu output
IntelPerfSpect3_run: start the Intel PerfSpect 3 metrics collection subprocess with a configurable report interval
ARMPerfUtil_install: install the ARM topdown-tool by cloning the telemetry solution repo and running pip install
